acceptance: The #708 blocked Outcome is bound to #713 by the public #682 successor/quarantine receipt with standing user authority, and #708 evidence is not manually rewritten, rebased, stashed, archived, or discarded.
The current synchronization CLI accepts an explicit target worktree root, resolves Contract and Summary only inside that root, and passes that same root to all validation and mutation paths.
Focused regressions use a dirty target fixture while the caller root is distinct and prove target-only baseline advancement and caller-root evidence isolation.
The source Makefile, installed Makefile template, English/Japanese workflow guidance, contract guidance, and generated capability/documentation projections expose the same TARGET_ROOT behavior.
Strict Finish, archive, PR, merge, and closure follow normal lifecycle after #710's locked quality toolchain is used; this Work Item makes no release or adjacent Work Item completion claim.
